I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It hasn't been opened in a browser, so I haven't checked how it renders.

The screen is 1280px wide inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS only. It follows `DESIGN.md`:
- **Heading and button:** "Team" is the page heading, with an ink pill "Invite Member" button next to it.
- **Member list:** the five members are in a bordered card. Each row has initials, name, email and a labeled role select (Admin, Editor or Viewer) set to the role you gave.
- **Look:** it uses only the palette colors, sizes, radii and spacing from `DESIGN.md`. Rows tint on hover, and the button and selects have accent focus rings.
- **Extra chrome:** I added a small "Harbor" wordmark bar at the top. I also added "Member" and "Role" column labels over the list. Neither is in your content list, so remove them if "exactly this content" means nothing extra.

Unbounded and Archivo can't be loaded, since no assets are allowed. The CSS names them first and falls back to Helvetica Neue or Arial, so the screen will look different unless they're installed locally.
